reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

posts.text: Proud to support the Major Richard Star Act, helping ensure combat-injured veterans receive the full retirement pay and disability compensation they have earned. Our veterans have sacrificed so much for our country, and they deserve every benefit they’ve earned through their

Today, we honor the men and women who have served our country and defended our freedom. To our veterans in Northeastern Pennsylvania and across the nation, thank you for your courage, sacrifice, and service. We owe you a debt of gratitude that can never be repaid.

Happy Veterans https://t.co/Chw5ERTOsL

Last chance! Today is the final day to experience Reaper’s Revenge in Lackawanna County. I had the chance to check it out in October, and it’s definitely worth the trip. If you haven’t been yet, tonight’s your last opportunity! https://t.co/zb3TcLjs8r

Our team was proud to participate in State Rep. Fritz’s Senior Expo at Camp Ladore today! It was a great opportunity for the team to connect with seniors, answer questions, share resources, and hear directly about the issues that matter most to them. https://t.co/xYPeJoYcYG

When NEPA residents run into problems with federal agencies, our office is here to help.

We helped a Tamiment constituent recover more than $20,800 in IRS tax refunds and got a Plymouth corrections officer his DD214 within 24 hours so he could move forward with his military service retirement buyback.

These are real results for people across Northeastern Pennsylvania. If you're having trouble with a federal agency, our team is ready to help.

Great to be in Hazleton for the 9th International Karate Do Championship!

Congratulations to all the students on the hard work and dedication that brought you here. Karate teaches discipline, respect, confidence, and the importance of always pushing yourself to be better. Proud https://t.co/hfJ4Tdxu0h

Last week, we had the pleasure of celebrating Perry Hoffpauer’s 89th birthday at Glenmaura Senior Living in Moosic. We’re grateful for the chance to honor Perry, an Army veteran, with a Congressional coin and celebrate this special milestone with him. Happy 89th, Perry! https://t.co/b9Q3es4RdB

Fentanyl is devastating families and communities across Pennsylvania. We need to crack down on traffickers, support law enforcement, and expand access to treatment.

I’ve supported legislation to combat fentanyl and secured over $1 million for the Monroe County DA’s Opioid Crimes https://t.co/qQzcSnwben

A law school in Northeastern Pennsylvania means more opportunities for our students to earn a quality education and pursue a career close to home.

Investing in education helps build a stronger workforce, supports our local economy, and gives the next generation more reasons to stay and put down roots in NEPA. I’m glad to see Misericordia University helping make that possible.

Seniors should not have to wait on paperwork to get the care their doctor prescribed. I’m proud to cosponsor the Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act and fight for faster decisions and a modernized prior authorization system for Medicare Advantage. https://t.co/t4vHrlOcce

Great to join PA Inclusive for its Harvest Dinner and celebrate the important work they do to create opportunities, build independence, and make NEPA a more inclusive place to live and work. Congratulations to all of this year’s award recipients! https://t.co/HNtDS8dNC6

Our Director of Outreach, Leo, joined Enhanced Hearing Specialists for their ribbon cutting as the Cillo family celebrated new ownership of the Dickson City practice. It’s great to see a Pennsylvania family come home, invest in our community, and continue serving families across NEPA. Welcome home, Cillo family!

If you've been waiting on your tax refund or are having trouble resolving an issue with the IRS, you don't have to navigate it alone.

Our office regularly helps constituents communicate with the IRS and other federal agencies to resolve casework and get answers. If you need assistance, we're here to help.

Pilots and air traffic controllers work together every day to keep our skies safe, but very few see their partner’s side of the job. I co-led the FLIGHT DECK Act to give controllers a view into the cockpit, helping pilots and controllers better understand each other’s responsibilities. When both sides can see the full picture, our entire aviation system is safer. https://t.co/cqRwadNL17

Today, we celebrate Columbus Day and recognize the contributions of Italian Americans who have helped shape our nation. Christopher Columbus’s 1492 voyage remains a significant chapter in history, and this day is an opportunity to honor Italian American heritage, culture, and the generations who have strengthened our communities and our country.

A Philadelphia police officer was ambushed and killed simply for wearing the badge and answering the call. Another officer was shot and critically wounded.

These men put their lives on the line to protect the public, and one of them paid the ultimate price. My prayers are with the fallen officer’s family, the wounded officer and his family, and the entire Philadelphia Police Department.

We must never forget the sacrifice our law enforcement officers make to keep our communities safe.

An execution shouldn’t be a live-streamed spectacle. The focus should be on justice for the victims and their families, not turning an execution into entertainment. Their pain deserves respect, not a public show.

Excited to see Exeter Commons get underway. Wawa is just the beginning. This development will bring new businesses, jobs, and opportunities to Exeter while giving local families more places to shop, work, and spend time together.

That’s the kind of responsible growth we need across Northeastern Pennsylvania. Congratulations to everyone who helped make this project happen!

Housing costs are putting real pressure on families across Northeastern Pennsylvania.

We brought local realtors, developers, educators, and housing leaders together to hear what they’re seeing on the ground and what Congress can do to make housing more affordable.

We need to build more homes, cut unnecessary barriers, and make sure working families have a fair shot at owning a home.

Three years later, we remember the innocent lives taken on October 7th.

Hamas deliberately targeted civilians, murdered families, and took hostages. There is no justification for that kind of evil.

Today, we mourn the victims, stand with their families, reject antisemitism, and reaffirm our commitment to standing with Israel.

posts.text:
Reliable rural broadband is no longer a luxury, it’s a necessity. 
 
By passing the Rural Broadband Affordability Act though the Farm Bill, rural families and small businesses will have better access to the reliable, affordable internet they deserve, and we’re working to make that a reality across NEPA.

When we say we’re going to do something, we see it through.

From visiting before I was even sworn in, to securing $3 million in federal funding last spring, to now helping move a $37 million USDA loan forward, we’ve stayed committed to the new Wayne Pike Career and Technical Center.

Another big step toward creating more opportunities for NEPA students and building the skilled workforce our region needs.

Tyler on our team attended East Stroudsburg University’s Legislative Fellow Breakfast last week, where State Rep. Doyle Heffley was named the 2026-27 ESU Legislative Fellow. Congratulations to Rep. Heffley on this well-deserved recognition! https://t.co/wKNzA9PnxJ

When you’re stuck dealing with a federal agency, you don’t have to figure it out alone.

Our office helps constituents get answers from agencies like the Social Security Administration, VA, IRS, and more. If you need help with a federal agency, call our team at (570) 763-6120. https://t.co/srM2Hn0rvL

Last week, we celebrated Willis Ide’s 102nd birthday at The Village at Greenbriar Senior Living in Dallas. It was a wonderful afternoon honoring this incredible milestone and celebrating Willis with family, friends, and the Greenbriar community. 🎉 https://t.co/Ibi8ras75T

Insurance companies have a responsibility to manage healthcare costs, but that should never mean putting profits ahead of patients. 

We need reforms that cut red tape, hold insurance companies accountable, and make sure medical decisions are driven by doctors and patients, not the bottom line.

Last week, we spent some time at Ronald McDonald House Charities of Scranton to see firsthand how they support families during some of the toughest moments of their lives. Keeping families close when their children need care is important work, and it was great to meet the people making that possible right here in NEPA.

On Saturday, Leo attended Benjamin Desarro’s Eagle Scout Ceremony in Avoca to celebrate his hard work, leadership, and commitment to his community. Congratulations, Benjamin, on this incredible achievement! https://t.co/ZZQOq39xqV

The Wright Center understands that improving healthcare is about more than putting a doctor in an exam room. These grants will help The Wright Center continue that mission and build a stronger healthcare workforce right here in our region. https://t.co/u77KPbCK2K

Great to visit Building Blocks Scranton and see firsthand the new facility they’ve built right here in downtown Scranton.

This is the kind of investment that matters, giving local families access to quality childcare and giving our kids the strong start they deserve. It was great to see the center in action and hear about the work it took to bring this project to life.

Getting answers from the federal government shouldn’t be this difficult.

Whether you’re dealing with the IRS, Medicare, Social Security, veterans’ benefits, or another federal agency, our office is here to help. Just call us (570) 763-6120. https://t.co/dRqHSH9VMa

The Luzerne County Veterans Affairs bus trip made it to D.C., yesterday. They visited Arlington National Cemetery to lay a wreath and honor those who gave everything in service to our country, followed by a visit to the U.S. Capitol. 

Proud to have NEPA’s veterans in Washington. https://t.co/UJ81WRrd9f
The Bresnavan was out and about this weekend! Our team chatted with the Scott Township community at the Justus Volunteer Fire Co Fall Festival on Saturday. https://t.co/X6TjGQtXj5
